Code block inside a blockquote keeps its line indentation

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<blockquote><pre><code>line1\n    line2 indented</code></pre></blockquote>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
